segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, thanks for making time, Dana. I wanted to walk through the updated quote for 42 seats and make sure the June 17 go-live still lines up on your side.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yep, that date still works. We have 38 users confirmed today, and I asked for four extra seats because finance and operations may each add two people in July.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: That makes sense. The quote has 42 annual seats at $96 per seat per month, billed annually, so the software total is $48,384. Implementation is the standard $6,500 one-time fee.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. On the implementation fee, can that be on the first invoice, or does it need to be paid before kickoff?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: It can be on the first invoice. The billing tool will generate that after signature, with net 30 terms. We don’t need payment in hand to start the kickoff.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Good. Our AP team needs the purchase order number on the invoice. I can get you the PO by Friday, likely for $54,884 total.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Perfect. I’ll add a note for the PO field before finance pushes the invoice. For contract term, we have July 1, 2026 through June 30, 2027, with the kickoff starting June 17 as pre-launch work.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That’s fine. And the renewal language, it says 60 days notice for non-renewal. Legal asked if that can be 45 days instead.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, so I checked with deal desk this morning. Forty-five days is approved, and I’ll update that in the order form before sending the final version.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Great. Send it over today if you can. If the numbers match what we discussed, I should be able to route it for signature tomorrow.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Will do. I’ll send the clean order form and the implementation summary by 3 p.m. Eastern, and I’ll include the seat count and June milestones in the email.
